verdict.rationale: PagerDuty provides extensive developer-facing interfaces (REST API, Events API v2, webhooks, and an official MCP server) that AI-native builders can integrate against, but the evidence never names dedicated language-specific 'official SDKs' (e.g., Python/Node/Java client libraries) — only raw API/webhook/MCP documentation. missing for 10: explicit official SDK packages/libraries, language-specific client SDK docs, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
